strings.en: We'll finish it with this ship!
This ship will take out that enemy!
All hands, fight in a manner worthy/　of the Steel Dragons!
We have to get through this,/　no matter what...!
Yes, ma'am. Let's clear a path for this ship.
We've come through crises like this many times before.
Yes, let's trust in everyone's strength.
We're engaging the enemy commander unit!
We're engaging the Golaikunru commander unit.
Rather a hard name to say, isn't it?
A museum would probably love to have that.
Either way, I question whoever/　sent something like that...
No life signs inside the target!
XO, we're engaging the Crystal Dragoon.
Understood. I'd wager its fragments/　would fetch a good price.
We can't let that enemy get any closer!
Is that enemy's goal to pin us down...?!
Let's pay it back for the other day.
We mustn't let it strike first!
Final target: XN-L!/　We must sink it here, no matter what!
To try to annihilate intelligent life when we don't/　even know how much of it exists in this universe...
We can't let ourselves be the first to fall!
All hands, prepare for anti-ship combat!
XO, we're engaging the enemy ship ahead.
We can't let the Zovorg units/　get near the Rabulpaila.
We'll take down the commander unit!
Captain, the Raftclans has come within range.
XO, we'll draw the enemy commander/　unit's attention to us.
Gadisword unit approaching at high speed!
Captain, those sorts of enemies are...
We can't afford to call them creepy./　Destroy them, quickly!
Merging has only made them creepier.
We can't let it transform any further.
We mustn't let the target escape!
A wing or two.../　won't hurt our fighting ability much./　More importantly, order a counterattack.
W-We can't take any more damage...!
Oh, this is nothing.../　Still better than the battle at Pluto.
Mmh...!/　That last hit was a bad one...!
Frames 20 and 30, port side!/　Heavy damage!
Send our Range 2 units to escort us!
Damage control to affected areas, hurry!
Kuh! We couldn't evade in time...!!
Kh! We mustn't let the enemy commander unit/　close in again!
It seems that deity ship lives up to its name...!
Whatever it is inside,/　we must stop it here!
The Raftclans will be back!/　Redeploy the barrage!
It may look like that, but its attacks are brutal...!
More troublesome than a fearsome-looking foe.
We can still handle this much, right?
This ship's Guard is quite tight, you know./　...Just like the Captain's.
Oho./　The enemy's focusing its fire on us.
Then, with this Hiryu Custom,/　we'll down as many enemies as we can!
That enemy.../　Don't tell me it means to ram us...!?
Hmm... Perhaps it's the ship's color.
Return fire at once!/　We mustn't let the Lamaris overwhelm us!
The Lamaris are slipping through our barrage...!
We can't let them approach any further.
Can't be helped./　This ship's heavier than she looks./　...Just like the Captain.
Going after the mothership by the book...?
Then,/　let's show them this ship is more/　than a simple refit.
Don't let your guard down, Captain./　The enemy seems to be zeroing in on us.
Oho, a hit right on the sweet spot.
Um, XO, this is no time to be impressed...
Frames 20 and 30, port side. Minor damage.
Be bold in your approach./　Or you'll never win over the Captain.
True, being aggressive might be better...
What are you two talking about!
Port landing deck, damage is minor.
Redeploy the barrage!/　We mustn't let the enemy commander unit approach!
XN-L.../　Could it be gauging how we'll respond...?
We mustn't let that thing approach!
Yes, for the Captain's sake as well.
We mustn't let the Lamaris get any closer...!
We can't keep up with that speed...!
We'd best avoid fighting the Raftclans/　at this distance.
Ugh, gross... I'm gonna have nightmares.
Not quite a graceful sidestep, but...
We can't let that thing possess us.
My, my,/　missing a target this big?/　Sloppy work.
Phew... We managed to dodge it.
All thanks to your beauty, Captain.
D-does that have anything to do with it?
Not another one of my photos!?
No, no, something else entirely... Heh heh heh.
We've fought Zeranio-class ships/　many times, after all.
...They're creepy foes,/　but better than the Yokijin.
If possible, keep that disgusting thing/　from getting near us again...
An attack like that won't work on us!
Um... You say that like it's/　someone else's problem...
We'll need to be thorough about/　conserving from now on.
U-um, isn't that them over there?
Once we're in, we'll move to support fire!
Leave the rest to this ship!
Dragon 2 to Steel 2!/　Moving to support!
Dragon 2 to Iron 3!/　Moving to support!
This ship will block it!/　All hands, brace for impact!
Full battle speed! Shield our units!
We can't let this chance slip!
Open all launch ports, both sides!/　Missile, fire!
Open upper missile tubes, both sides!/　Fire!
All upper missiles, both sides, fire!!
To all gun turrets.../　Shoot down the target, and I'll tell/　you a secret about the Captain.
Dragon 2 to all units!/　We're about to fire our Main Cannons!
Gunners, down the target, and/　I'll give you a photo of the Captain.
Gunners, down the target, and/　I'll throw in photos of Eun/　along with the Captain's!
Fine by me, but I'll be charging/　you for them later.
Final range check. Correcting elevation/　by 2 degrees.
Captain, now's the time for the/　Hypergravity Impact Cannon.
Dragon 2 to all units!/　Clear the line of fire immediately!
All hands, brace for impact and flash!
Dragon 2 to all units!/　We will now fire the/　Hypergravity Impact Cannon!
